pairs: Omnis anima potestatibus sublimioribus subdita sit:
Let every soul be subject to higher authorities.
non est enim potestas nisi a Deo: quæ autem sunt, a Deo ordinatæ sunt.
For there is no authority except from God and those who have been ordained by God.
resists what has been ordained by God.
And those who resist are acquiring damnation for themselves.
nam principes non sunt timori boni operis,
For leaders are not a source of fear to those who work good,
but to those who work evil.
And would you prefer not to be afraid of authority?
and you shall have praise from them.
Dei enim minister est tibi in bonum.
For he is a minister of God for you unto good.
But if you do what is evil,
non enim sine causa gladium portat.
For it is not without reason that he carries a sword.
For he is a minister of God;
vindex in iram ei qui malum agit.
an avenger to execute wrath upon whomever does evil.
Ideo necessitate subditi estote non solum propter iram,
For this reason, it is necessary to be subject, not solely because of wrath,
For they are the ministers of God,
Therefore, render to all whatever is owed.
Taxes, to whom taxes is due;
revenue, to whom revenue is due;
fear, to whom fear is due;
honor, to whom honor is due.
You should owe nothing to anyone,
except so as to love one another.
qui enim diligit proximum, legem implevit.
For whoever loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
You shall not speak false testimony.
et si quod est aliud mandatum,
And if there is any other commandment,
it is summed up in this word:
You shall love your neighbor as yourself.
The love of neighbor does no harm. Therefore,
love is the plenitude of the law.
And we know the present time,
quia hora est jam nos de somno surgere.
that now is the hour for us to rise up from sleep.
Nunc enim propior est nostra salus, quam cum credidimus.
For already our salvation is closer than when we first believed.
and the day draws near. Therefore,
let us cast aside the works of darkness,
and be clothed with the armor of light.
Let us walk honestly, as in the daylight,
not in promiscuity and sexual immorality,
Instead, be clothed with the Lord Jesus Christ,
et carnis curam ne feceritis in desideriis.
and make no provision for the flesh in its desires.
